description: For a gift from a group of friends: returns an invite link (inviteUrl) that lets anyone who opens it signed in edit the quest together with the owner, plus the current team. enabled=false turns the link off; rotate=true replaces it with a new one (the old link stops working). Owner only. The link grants edit access — send it only to the co-givers, never to the recipient.

edit_token.description: Only for quests not created with this owner key (the part after # in an editUrl)

name: share_quest
title: Share a quest for co-editing
